verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a SaaS incorporation and company-management service, so user-driven bulk operations (for example, sending many SAFEs or granting equity to many people at once) are a fair axis. However, the evidence documents no bulk-action capability. Automatically filing 83(b) elections for all founders is an internal automated step, not a user-invoked bulk operation, and no API or OpenAPI surface was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
